app.name: DoseMinder
app.tagline: Your medicine on time... and your family at ease
app.description: A smart app that reminds you to take your medication, keeps your family and doctor reassured, and shows your schedule even offline.

common.disclaimer: This information is for awareness only and does not replace your doctor or pharmacist.
common.no_drug_info: No verified information available for this medication
common.saved_offline: Saved on this device — will sync when you're online
common.offline_limitation: Time-based push reminders need internet. Offline, reminders appear only while the app is open.

landing.heroTitle: Your medicine on time... and your family at ease
landing.heroSubtitle: A smart app that reminds you to take your medication, keeps your family and doctor reassured, and shows your schedule even offline.
landing.step1Desc: Type your medication name or take a clear photo of your prescription to organize doses accurately.
landing.step2Title: Get reminded at the exact time
landing.step2Desc: Clear visual and voice reminders notify you at dose time with a large, simple confirmation button.
landing.step3Desc: Automatic alerts to your family if you miss a dose, and secure adherence tracking for your doctor with your consent.
landing.rolesTitle: Designed for everyone in your care circle
landing.rolesSubtitle: A tailored experience connecting patients, family caregivers, and physicians seamlessly
landing.patientRoleDesc: Ultra-clear interface with large buttons, 1-tap confirmation, and offline schedule support.
landing.caregiverRoleDesc: Real-time dashboard and smart missed-dose alerts with automatic escalation.
landing.doctorRoleDesc: Accurate adherence reports strictly gated by explicit patient consent.
landing.escalationSubtitle: An automated timeline ensuring no dose is missed, starting gently and escalating only when needed
landing.escalationStep3Desc: Push and in-app alerts to caregivers
landing.escalationStep5Desc: Email and secure link to emergency contacts
landing.featuresSubtitle: Thoughtful healthcare technology designed for users of all ages
landing.feature1Desc: Native dual-language support with bidirectional isolation for medical terms and numerals.
landing.feature2Title: Your schedule is available even offline
landing.feature2Desc: Your schedule and medications stay viewable without internet, and your confirmations are saved on your device and synced when you're back online.
landing.feature3Desc: Audio readout of medication name and dosage for elderly and visually impaired users.
landing.feature4Desc: Full control over your health data; grant or revoke doctor access instantly.
landing.feature5Desc: Bold typography, oversized touch targets, and a single main action per screen.
landing.feature6Desc: Installable Progressive Web App (PWA) with fast access from your home screen.
landing.footerMedical: Medical disclaimer: DoseMinder is an organizational aid and does not replace medical advice.
